No, you do not have to pay anything to return or replace a damaged item.
When a product arrives damaged from shipping, we replace the item at our expense (including free shipping for the replacement) or issue a full refund for the purchase price if a replacement is unavailable.
Unlike standard returns, damaged items are not subject to any freight return costs or restocking fees.
